premise: Raccoon and Ladybug find a shining silver line across the moss and follow it, sure it leads to treasure; it leads to Snail, who has been leaving it so his friends can always find him.
inspiration: Hansel and Gretel's breadcrumb trail (Grimm), turned: no one is lost and no trail is eaten; the trail is a gift that says come find me.
lesson: Leaving a way for friends to find you is a kind of love.

en-US.title: Snail's Silver Trail
en-US.text: Look! said Raccoon. On the moss, in the morning light, was a thin silver line. It {raccoon:sparkle 0.5} shimmered. Treasure, whispered Raccoon. Ladybug {ladybug:hop} landed beside them. A trail! Let's follow it! So they did. Over the leaf. Round the stone. Under the ferns, Raccoon {raccoon:pulse} sniffing, Ladybug {ladybug:float x2} flying ahead. Past Mushroom, who nodded hello. The silver line got shinier and shinier and then, right at the end of it... {snail:pulse} Snail. Sitting in a sunny spot, eating a leaf. Hello, said Snail. You found me. Raccoon blinked. Where's the treasure? Snail, she said, did you make that? I always do, said Snail. So that whoever wants me can find me. Raccoon sat down in the sun beside him. {raccoon:hearts} {ladybug:hearts} Found you, said Raccoon. That'll do.

es-ES.title: El rastro de plata de Caracol
es-ES.text: ¡Mirad!, dijo Mapache. Sobre el musgo, con la luz de la mañana, había una línea fina de plata. {raccoon:sparkle 0.5} Brillaba. Un tesoro, susurró Mapache. Mariquita {ladybug:hop} se posó a su lado. ¡Un rastro! ¡Vamos a seguirlo! Y lo siguieron. Por la hoja. Alrededor de la piedra. Bajo los helechos, Mapache {raccoon:pulse} olfateando, Mariquita {ladybug:float x2} volando delante. Junto a Seta, que saludó con la cabeza. La línea de plata brillaba más y más y al final, justo al final... {snail:pulse} Caracol. Sentado al sol, comiéndose una hoja. Hola, dijo Caracol. Me habéis encontrado. Mapache parpadeó. ¿Dónde está el tesoro? Caracol, dijo, ¿eso lo has hecho tú? Siempre lo hago, dijo Caracol. Para que quien me busque me encuentre. Mapache se sentó al sol a su lado. {raccoon:hearts} {ladybug:hearts} Te encontré, dijo Mapache. Con eso me basta.
